cues: A transverse section often looks faintly three-sided, with its soft interior arranged around a central axis.
When freshly cut, the exposed flesh slowly takes on a tan-brown color in ordinary air.
Before full maturity, cut surfaces can release a milky sap that sticks to fingers or blades.
Botanically, its edible portion is a berry, although its familiar form is far from spherical.
Dried slices usually bend with a chewy feel instead of breaking with a crisp snap.
Cold storage may darken the peel while leaving the enclosed flesh comparatively pale and intact.
